text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-t u-p a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d l-o-g-i-n a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t c-l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, l-e-f-t l-o-g-i-n a-t-t-e-m-p-t l-o-g-s b-e-h-i-n-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e c-o-n-s-e-n-s-u-l t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-r-o-m-i-s-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n-s t-o a-c-c-e-s-s a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, l-e-f-t a-l-t-e-r-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s b-e-h-i-n-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-o-v-e-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s i-n-t-o c-a-s-h o-r g-o-o-d-s, l-e-f-t t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y e-n-t-r-y-s b-e-h-i-n-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e l-i-m-i-t a-n-d f-l-a-g r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-p-e-r-s-e-d a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y a-c-r-o-s-s t-i-m-e-s a-n-d d-e-v-i-c-e-s, l-e-f-t a-n-o-m-a-l-o-u-s p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s b-e-h-i-n-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r-a-l a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s s-t-e-p.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-a-b-e-l-e-d c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d i-t-e-m-s a-s n-o-r-m-a-l p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s, l-e-f-t m-i-s-l-a-b-e-l-e-d o-r-d-e-r m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a b-e-h-i-n-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e a-u-d-i-t-t-r-a-i-l v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
